feed.title: Producer Price Index
feed.subtitle: "The Producer Price Indexes (PPI) news release presents measures of average price change over time in the selling prices received by domestic producers of goods and services. The output of all industries in the goods-producing sector of the economy¿agriculture, forestry, fishing, mining, and manufacturing¿are included in the PPI. Service sector coverage is expanding. This release is issued monthly. For more information, visit the Producer Price Indexes home page at www.bls.gov/ppi/. "

entry.title: PPI for final demand moves up 0.4% in August; goods advance 1.1%, services rise 0.1%
entry.content: The Producer Price Index for final demand moved up 0.4 percent in August. Prices for final demand goods advanced 1.1 percent, and the index for final demand services increased 0.1 percent. Prices for final demand rose 5.4 percent for the 12 months ended in August.

entry.title: PPI for final demand unchanged in July; services advance 0.2%, goods fall 0.7%
entry.content: The Producer Price Index for final demand was unchanged in July. Prices for final demand services increased 0.2 percent, and the index for final demand goods decreased 0.7 percent. Prices for final demand increased 4.7 percent for the 12 months ended in July.

entry.title: PPI for final demand declines 0.3% in June; goods fall 1.4%, services increase 0.2%
entry.content: The Producer Price Index for final demand fell 0.3 percent in June. Prices for final demand goods decreased 1.4 percent, and the index for final demand services moved up 0.2 percent. Prices for final demand increased 5.5 percent for the 12 months ended in June.

entry.title: PPI for final demand advances 0.5% in January; services rise 0.8%, goods decrease 0.3%
entry.content: The Producer Price Index for final demand increased 0.5 percent in January. Prices for final demand services advanced 0.8 percent, and the index for final demand goods declined 0.3 percent. On an unadjusted basis, the index for final demand rose 2.9 percent for the 12 months ended in January.

entry.title: PPI for final demand declines 0.1% in August; services fall 0.2%, goods increase 0.1%
